header.description: Accuracy, hit chance and dodge (FAM-06): CalculateAccuracy, CalculateBackstabAccuracy, CalculateAttackDefense, CalcDodgeVSAccuracy, CalcDodge, DodgeMaxAccForPercent, the hit/dodge caps and the GMUD helpers. Stock path only (bGreaterMUD false).
notes: Cases that read a Classes row carry it as an extra 'class' input (number, combat_lvl, armour_type), or null when the lookup fails, written from the stock database because the Rust port never reads SQLite.
Optional arguments are omitted in a few cases to pin MME's defaults; arguments only GreaterMUD reads (eEvil, intellect, charm, attack type) are passed to show they have no effect on stock.
GetDodgeCap, GetHitMin and GMUD_IsLightArmourClass are called directly with arbitrary class numbers.
